title: 反义疑问句（前肯后否/前否后肯，如He is tall, isn't he?）
knowledgePoint: 反义疑问句的核心规则（前肯后否/前否后肯）、主谓一致原则、否定词辨析（never/seldom/few等）、情态动词的反义疑问搭配、祈使句/特殊句式的反义疑问、回答逻辑（根据事实回应）

questions.question: The research team has made significant progress in developing the new material, ______?
questions.explanation: 前半句为肯定句，反义疑问用否定式；主语the research team为单数集体名词，用it指代，助动词与前文has一致，故用hasn't it。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 单数集体名词（team/group/company等）作主语时，反义疑问用it指代；强调成员时可用they，但正式语境中优先用it。

questions.question: She seldom attends social events because she prefers quiet environments, doesn't she?
questions.explanation: 前半句含否定词seldom（很少），属于“前否后肯”结构，反义疑问应为does she，题干误用前肯后否，语法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见否定词：never/seldom/hardly/scarcely/few/little/rarely等，前半句含这些词时，反义疑问用肯定式。

questions.question: Few people realize the long-term impact of plastic pollution on marine ecosystems, ______?
questions.explanation: 前半句含否定词few（很少），反义疑问用肯定式；主语people为复数，助动词用do，故用do they。
questions.knowledgeExtension: few修饰可数名词复数、little修饰不可数名词，均表否定含义，反义疑问需用肯定式。

questions.question: The museum will open a new exhibition on ancient civilizations next month, won't it?
questions.explanation: 前半句为肯定的一般将来时，反义疑问用否定式won't it，主谓一致，符合“前肯后否”规则，表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 一般将来时（will/be going to）的反义疑问：will对应won't，be going to对应aren't/isn't（如They are going to attend the meeting, aren't they?）。

questions.question: He must have finished the project ahead of schedule, ______? The deadline is still a week away.
questions.explanation: must have done表对过去的推测，且有明确语境（deadline is still a week away），反义疑问用助动词hasn't，与finished对应。
questions.knowledgeExtension: must表推测时，反义疑问的助动词根据must后的动词时态确定（对过去推测用have/has，对现在推测用be动词/实义动词助动词）。

questions.question: Don't forget to submit your application before midnight, will you? The system will close automatically after that.
questions.explanation: 否定祈使句的反义疑问用will you，是固定用法；题干提醒“午夜前提交申请”，逻辑连贯，语法正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 肯定祈使句的反义疑问用will you/won't you（如Please pass the salt, will you?）；否定祈使句只能用will you。

questions.question: This is the first time she has participated in an international competition, ______?
questions.explanation: 前半句主语为this，反义疑问用it指代；谓语动词为is，前肯后否，故用isn't it，与后面的has participated无关（核心谓语是is）。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 含定语从句/强调句的反义疑问，需根据主句的主谓确定，而非从句的主谓。

questions.question: They have little chance to win the championship, haven't they? Their main competitor is much stronger.
questions.explanation: 前半句含否定词little（几乎没有），反义疑问需用肯定式have they，题干误用前肯后否，语法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: little（表数量）、a little（表肯定）的区别：little含否定含义，反义疑问用肯定；a little含肯定含义，反义疑问用否定（如They have a little time, don't they?）。

questions.question: You'd better adjust your schedule to avoid the rush hour, ______?
questions.explanation: You'd better=You had better，反义疑问用hadn't you，是固定搭配，与would无关。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见情态动词短语的反义疑问：had better→hadn't you；would rather→wouldn't you；used to→didn't you/usedn't you。

questions.question: There are few effective measures to solve the problem immediately, are there?
questions.explanation: 前半句含否定词few，反义疑问用肯定式are there；there be句型的反义疑问仍用there，符合规则，表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: there be句型的反义疑问结构：be动词+there（前肯后否/前否后肯）（如There is a park nearby, isn't there?）。

questions.question: He ought to apologize for his rude behavior during the meeting, ______?
questions.explanation: ought to表“应该”，反义疑问用oughtn't he或shouldn't he，选项中oughtn't he更贴合原情态动词，优先选择。
questions.knowledgeExtension: ought to的反义疑问有两种形式：oughtn't he/shouldn't he，正式语境中优先用与原词一致的oughtn't he。

questions.question: She has never been to South America, hasn't she? She often talks about her travel plans there.
questions.explanation: 前半句含否定词never，反义疑问需用肯定式has she，题干误用前肯后否，语法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: never/ever/just/already/yet等词不影响反义疑问的肯否，仅否定词（never/seldom等）才触发“前否后肯”。

questions.question: The data collected from the experiment doesn't support the initial hypothesis, ______?
questions.explanation: 前半句为否定句（doesn't support），反义疑问用肯定式；主语the data为不可数名词，用it指代，助动词与doesn't一致，故用does it。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不可数名词（data/information/knowledge等）作主语时，反义疑问用it指代，助动词用单数形式。

questions.question: Let's discuss the proposal in detail after the meeting, shall we?
questions.explanation: Let's（让我们）开头的祈使句，反义疑问用shall we，是固定用法；题干符合规则，表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: Let us（请求对方允许）开头的祈使句，反义疑问用will you（如Let us leave early, will you?）；Let's（包含对方）用shall we。

questions.question: He used to work as a journalist for an international newspaper, ______?
questions.explanation: used to表“过去常常”，反义疑问可用didn't he或usedn't he，两者均符合语法规则，故选择both A and B。
questions.knowledgeExtension: used to的反义疑问有两种常见形式，日常交流中didn't he更常用，正式语境中usedn't he也可。

questions.question: The new policy must be implemented strictly to achieve the desired effect, mustn't it?
questions.explanation: must表“必须”时，反义疑问用needn't（不必），而非mustn't（禁止），题干误用反义疑问词，语法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: must表“必须”时，反义疑问用needn't；表“推测”时，反义疑问根据must后的动词确定（如He must be at home, isn't he?）。

questions.question: Not only the manager but also the employees are satisfied with the new welfare system, ______?
questions.explanation: 前半句为肯定句，反义疑问用否定式；not only...but also...连接主语时，主谓一致遵循“就近原则”，靠近谓语的employees为复数，用they指代，助动词用are，故用aren't they。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 就近原则适用于not only...but also.../either...or.../neither...nor.../there be等结构，反义疑问的主谓需与靠近的主语一致。

questions.question: He can hardly understand the technical terms in the report, can he?
questions.explanation: 前半句含否定词hardly（几乎不），反义疑问用肯定式can he；情态动词can的反义疑问仍用can，符合规则，表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 情态动词（can/may/should/would等）的反义疑问，助动词与原情态动词一致（如She should arrive on time, shouldn't she?）。

questions.question: It is impossible to finish the task within such a short time, ______?
questions.explanation: 前半句为肯定句（it is impossible），反义疑问用否定式；主语为形式主语it，助动词与is一致，故用isn't it（impossible是形容词，不改变句子肯否）。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 形式主语it（it is+adj.+to do/that从句）的反义疑问，用it指代，助动词与is/was一致，与形容词是否表否定无关。

questions.question: — You haven't submitted the report yet, have you? — No, I haven't. I need two more days to polish it.
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句的回答遵循“事实一致”原则：实际未提交（否定事实），用No+否定回答，逻辑通顺；题干问答符合规则，表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 反义疑问句的回答不分“前肯后否/前否后肯”，仅根据实际事实：肯定事实用Yes+肯定回答，否定事实用No+否定回答。
